tasks.title: Fix user signup validation and duplicate email handling
tasks.description: The signup endpoint currently allows duplicate emails and does not validate password strength. Fix the signup view to: 1) Ensure email is unique (case-insensitive). 2) Validate that password is at least 8 characters and contains at least one digit. Return appropriate error messages with status 400 for invalid input. The endpoint is POST /api/signup/ and expects JSON with 'email' and 'password'.

tasks.title: Implement todo creation with proper ownership and validation
tasks.description: The todo creation endpoint currently allows creating todos without authentication and does not validate the title. Fix the POST /api/todos/ endpoint to: 1) Require authentication (use IsAuthenticated permission). 2) Automatically assign the todo to the authenticated user. 3) Validate that title is not empty and does not exceed 200 characters. Return 400 for invalid data. The Todo model has fields: title (CharField max_length=200), completed (BooleanField default=False), user (ForeignKey to User).

tasks.title: Optimize todo listing with pagination and query efficiency
tasks.description: The GET /api/todos/ endpoint currently returns all todos for the user without pagination and causes N+1 queries when serializing user information. Fix the endpoint to: 1) Use pagination with page size 10. 2) Use select_related to avoid N+1 queries (if user info is included). 3) Ensure only the authenticated user's todos are returned. The response should include 'count', 'next', 'previous', and 'results' fields.
